scope: Independent L08 functional observation lane design only. No source edits, tests, native launches, process operations or cleanup undertaken by this reviewer.

Backup exclusion precedes required directory Complete equality. Missing directory key fails at506, so required file equality510 and bounded ciphertext header516 are not executed. Diagnostic sibling query does not change reachability.

Any failed execute emits a closed FAIL, sets finished, zeroes expected payload/releases game probes and cancels the singleton observer scope. Simply continuing Swift assertions cannot restore a functioning observer.
13 boots execute sequentially. l08StorageAction at54-78 requires result.status=PASS (74). IOSAppLaunchUITests.swift.in5 sets continueAfterFailure=false, ending this test at the first failed action.
L08 storage is inserted before L08 host and before existing local-game/OS matrices. Failure therefore blocks those later calls as well.

Available closed records are preserved first, then verify_xctest requires exactly five passed tests. Failure stops later full per-observation framework provenance binding and independent gate evaluation at812-857.

preserved_real_obligations: Whodunit: actual bundled last-dinner, pure reducer/config through real PassAndPlaySessionController, Round1 clue history; restarted store equality plus production recovery/case validator and original Home route; actual flow-attached canonical controller continued through real actions to PostGame.

Mafia: real ConfigureAndStart setting, ON four effective same-target nights; OFF alternate, explicit skip, then pre-skip target plus rejected adjacent repeat; Night5 restart equality and real recovery; actual attached controller continued to Town winner and terminal Doctor cleanup.

Healthy legacy migration, malformed neighbor isolation, recognized damaged authenticated/current record plus recoverable legacy retention; actual Home/Retry/Discard and later exact NotFound (never Unavailable).

recommendation.decision: A separate explicitly named functional-observation companion lane is justified by deterministic harness coupling; it is not a replacement or PASS for strict L08. Implementation needs independent review and fresh root-owned execution.
recommendation.preserve: Keep original strict templates/parsers, native09 failure and frozen source09 byte-for-byte. No permissive flag in verify_storage, no test skip/xfail, no suppression of Complete metadata failure.
recommendation.isolation: New exact scenario/receipt names, fresh source manifest, owned Simulator and run token; never continue/reuse native09 data. No new production API or settings.
recommendation.minimal_separation: Use the same complete 13-boot/20-command real-store/game/controller/legacy paths in an independently reviewed copy-only companion. At all six metadata call sites, perform the same owned-path, file-type/existence, backup exclusion and bounded ciphertext header prerequisites. Separately evaluate both original Complete comparisons and retain each explicit PASS/FAIL/unobserved result rather than throwing before unrelated functional obligations. Do not call the original command and catch its exception: it releases/cancels required state.
recommendation.status_contract: No top-level app/storage PASS from collection alone. Report matrix collection completion, functional checks, directory/file Complete checks, provenance, and XCTest execution separately. A missing Complete key stays FAIL for the original assertion; unperformed/throwing observations stay unverified/FAIL, never inferred supported/unsupported. Overall strict L08 remains FAIL/BLOCKED until genuinely satisfied or separately authorized gate policy changes.
recommendation.fatal_conditions: Wrong context/path/type, missing file, backup exclusion failure, header/crypto/save/recovery/controller/identity errors, cancellation and receipt/bounds failure remain fatal for affected dependent operations. Do not repair metadata or rewrite files except the original explicitly synthetic legacy/tag fixture.
recommendation.proofs: Every companion action remains individually bound to token, boot UUID, ordinal, exact native images/source hash, real flow controller and executed XCTest receipt; validate full artifacts even when a disjoint metadata obligation is known failed. Matrix completion cannot infer unexecuted steps or pass existing verify_storage.
recommendation.runner: Either a narrow separate source-bound runner entry or a separate exact subgate that preserves evidence/provenance before reporting a known metadata failure. Preserve existing strict five-test validator unchanged; separately enumerate any new collector test instead of calling its result the original strict XCTest PASS.
recommendation.budgets: Retain single active command, 60s command bound, distinct receipts/20 operations/13 boots, payload zeroization, original observation ceilings and root-owned build/process cleanup. Do not increase ceilings to accommodate duplicate strict+companion data in one scenario.

affected_controls_if_approved: New companion Kotlin/Swift storage templates and exact receipt parser/tests under a new frozen isolated control directory.
l08_copy/copy registration only in that isolated lane; all production callers and existing game snapshot/controller drivers preserved.
Dedicated source binding/runner result selection and exact companion discovery; no change to original verify_storage, test_l08_diagnostics or original strict XCTest outcome.
Companion README: precise functional versus metadata versus device/Store limitations; current L08_README claims are historical and must not be used as runtime evidence.
negative_controls: Missing directory/file keys, present None/wrong class/non-string, NSError and unavailable/throwing observation retain distinct non-PASS results; supported volume never substitutes for Complete; missing constants never invented.
Original strict source assertions and all existing diagnostic rejection tests remain identical and execute; companion records must be rejected by original strict verify_storage.
Wrong token/scenario/process/ordinal/native source/UUID, stale receipt, reused boot, incomplete or reordered matrix, extra operation or extra secret fields rejected.
Backup exclusion false, path symlink/escape, file/header wrong, bound exceeded and cancellation remain fatal; no metadata setters or new fallback reads.
Unavailable/corrupt never NotFound; no manual terminal deletion; no fake controller or expected-state rebase; one real Home action and real Retry/Discard counts required.
Cover nested dual metadata sites before/after tamper plus legacy-load and retained-dual; a top-level-only separation is incomplete.
A successful parser fixture/control is not native evidence; missing actual XCTest/subgate provenance remains BLOCKED; failed metadata cannot be hidden by collector exit0.
